title: pxsig project config (pxsig.config.json)
description: Configures one project (package under test). Every key is optional. Relative paths are relative to the project folder; a path starting with "$workspace/" is relative to the workspace root.

path.description: A path relative to the project folder, "$workspace/…" relative to the workspace root, or absolute.

detailGate.description: Detail-channel rule: false turns it off, true uses the defaults, an object tunes it.

blockDelta.description: A kept tile changed when any of its blocks moved by more than this (0-255). Default 32.

energyDelta.description: A new edge appeared when a tile's edge energy rose by more than this (0-255). Default 48.

minTiles.description: Fail when at least this many tiles trip either rule. Default 3.

colorGate.description: Color rule: false turns it off, true uses the defaults, an object loosens or tightens it. Off, or a value past its maximum, is reported by pxsig doctor (gate-color-off).

deltaE.description: CIEDE2000 difference at which a flat pixel counts as changed. Default 3, at most 10.

minArea.description: Fail when at least this many connected flat pixels changed color. 0 turns the flat-area check off. Default 64, at most 1024.

cellDeltaE.description: CIEDE2000 difference of a cell's mean color at which the cell counts as changed. Default 5, at most 15.

minCells.description: Fail when at least this many cells changed color. 0 turns the cell check off. Default 3, at most 16.

gate.description: Gate thresholds. An entry fails when any rule trips.

threshold.description: Per-cell mean RGB delta (0-255) that counts a cell as changed. Default 24.

minCells.description: Fail when at least this many cells changed. 0 turns the rule off. Default 3.

minSsim.description: Fail when SSIM is below this. Default 0.99.

maxChangedPct.description: Fail when more than this percentage of cells changed. Default 2.

maxEdgePct.description: Fail when the Sobel edge-map difference is above this percentage. Off by default.

globals.description: Storybook globals in URL form, e.g. "theme:dark;density:compact".

extends.description: Another mode's name: its keys are copied first. One level only.

name.description: Project name in a single-package repository. In a monorepo the key in pxsig.workspace.json is the name.

label.description: What this project reviews, in your words ("Hydrotik"): the project switcher's option, and the dashboard title after "pxsig •" when the workspace has no label. Default: the project name. 1 to 60 characters.

srcRoot.description: The folder whose stories belong to this project.

url.description: Where Storybook serves index.json and iframe.html.

configDir.description: Storybook's config folder; used to resolve story paths from index.json.

staticDir.description: A built Storybook (index.json + iframe.html), served on a free 127.0.0.1 port when nothing answers at storybook.url.

layout.description: package: baselines in <store>/baselines/<component>/. colocated: baselines in <srcRoot>/<component>/__pxsig__/.

browserEndpoint.description: A Playwright browser server (ws://…) to render with instead of launching a browser, e.g. the container's from `pxsig browser start`. Also --browser and PXSIG_BROWSER_WS.

launchArgs.description: Chromium arguments added after pxsig's own (--disable-lcd-text, --font-render-hinting=none), so a later value of the same switch wins. Recorded in each render's environment (browser.launchArgs). Not passed to a browser server (capture.browserEndpoint), Firefox or WebKit.

ignore.description: Selectors masked in every story of the project (the inside of each element's box), besides every [data-volatile] element. Replaces the list inherited from the workspace defaults; capture.addIgnore adds to it.

addIgnore.description: Selectors added to the inherited capture.ignore list instead of replacing it.

waitFor.description: Extra waits, each applied when its selector matches.

minMs.description: Raise the minimum wait to this.

stableMarkup.description: Wait until the markup under this selector stops changing.

minCellPx.description: Adaptive grid: cells at least this many pixels, capped by grid. 0 turns it off.

detail.description: Write the detail channel into new baselines.

trim.description: Crop renders to their content (right and bottom). false turns it off.

modes.description: Named modes. A project's modes replace the workspace defaults and the built-in set.

defaultMode.description: The mode whose entries keep the bare story id. Default: the first mode.

modesByDefault.description: Modes every story renders in. Default: [defaultMode].

suites.description: Extra manifests (manifest.<suite>.json) for other mode sets.

workspaceDeps.description: A change in a workspace dependency's source selects every entry.

extra.description: More paths whose change selects every entry.

ignore.description: Globs for changed paths that select nothing when nothing traced claims them. Relative to the project; $workspace/ and $repo/ anchor a glob.

aliases.description: Import aliases only a bundler knows (Vite resolve.alias): specifier prefix → path. Longest prefix wins.

unresolved.description: Globs of files whose unresolved imports are accepted: they add no entries to every run. Anchored like affects.ignore.

env.description: The render environment each baseline records and each check compares (docs/configuration.md#env).

ignore.description: Fields left out of the comparison, e.g. render.timezone when no story formats a date.

fontProbe.description: Font families measured besides serif, sans-serif, monospace and system-ui (the design system's own), so a mismatch names the family.

strict.description: Refuse a check (exit 2, nothing rendered) when a selected baseline was approved in a different environment. Same as --strict-env and PXSIG_STRICT_ENV=1.

enforcement.description: Warn mode: per gate, enforce (fail the run, as before) or warn (report, exit advisoryExit). Only this committed config, or --warn from a person at a terminal, lowers a gate (docs/configuration.md#enforcement).

default.description: Every gate not named in gates.

visual.description: Check rows not passing: changed, new, render errors.

a11y.description: New axe violations against a11y.json. Default warn, quiet unless one appears; off: no a11y gate.

verify.description: approve verify: baselines with no log line (a mismatch or a rewritten log always fails).

env.description: --strict-env's refusal: under warn the check renders and lists the mismatches.

doctor.description: pxsig doctor findings at or above --fail-on.

stale.description: pxsig stale: stale or inconsistent verdicts.

warnUntil.description: End of warn mode (the end of that day, UTC): the warned gates are enforced after it, with no commit.

noticeDays.description: Days before warnUntil when every run starts saying it ends.

advisoryExit.description: Exit code of a run that would have failed only in warned gates: 0, or 10-125 for a forge's native warning state (GitLab allow_failure exit_codes, Jenkins UNSTABLE).

nonVisual.description: Top-level folders under srcRoot with no visual stories.

react.description: React features, alerts only (never an exit code). false (or "off") turns all of them off, like --no-react and PXSIG_REACT=off; true or an object leaves them on. A bad value is a warning and the part it belongs to off for the run (react.renders: render counting; any other key: the compiler analysis), never a failed check.

compiler.description: Compare the React Compiler's verdict on changed files with the merge base. "auto" (or true): with babel-plugin-react-compiler and @babel/core when they are installed in the project. "babel": that plugin only. "oxc": the engine's built-in compiler (oxc_react_compiler, experimental), with no Node packages. false (or "off"): never.

lint.description: Also the validation-only findings eslint-plugin-react-hooks reports (set-state-in-effect, …), on functions that still compile.

compilationMode.description: The compiler's compilationMode, as the project's build sets it.

target.description: The compiler's target. auto: the major of the react the project has (17, 18, 19; else 19).

environment.description: Compiler environment flags (JSON values), passed through as the project's build sets them.

exclude.description: Globs (workspace-relative) of changed files not analysed. Replaces the default list when set.

renders.description: Count React commits and component renders in every render (check rows' renders).

text.description: Text capture: each render also writes its text record (<id>.boxes.json: the text runs it draws, their boxes and font facts, and painted element boxes), and a baseline approved from that render stores it as its boxes section. Labels only: never a render, a gate or an exit code. On by default; false (or "off") turns it off, like --no-text and PXSIG_TEXT=off. A bad value is a warning and text capture off for the run, never a failed check.

ignore.description: CSS selectors whose text is never recorded, beside each entry's ignore masks.

movePx.description: Labels only: how far a text box may move (px) and still be in the same place.

edgePx.description: Labels only: how far around a text run's boxes (px) a changed pixel still belongs to it (anti-aliasing).

noisePx.description: Labels only: changed pixels outside text a text label (copy, reflow, moved, restyled) still allows.

sourceRoots.description: Workspace-relative folders whose edits can make a verdict stale. Default: srcRoot.

maxTracedFiles.description: Above this many edited files, staleness uses the same-folder rule.

renderSkewMs.description: A render written this long after its verdict makes the verdict stale.

manifests.description: Other manifests (relative to the store) whose baselines are not orphans. Default: every manifest.<suite>.json.

importPathPattern.description: Advanced: a regular expression selecting the project's story files, with the component folder as group 1. Default: files under srcRoot.

identity.description: No longer read (0.7.6): no log line names a person, whatever this says; the commit and the pull request say who. A config with the key still loads; pxsig doctor reports it (approvals-identity). Remove it.

level.description: standard: a typed phrase at a terminal, or the dashboard with the dashboard link. strict is reserved for a later release and refused for now.

reviewOrder.description: A workspace-relative JSON file that orders the review queue of baselines no person approved: `{ "first": [component, …], "usage": { component: count } }` (the components an adapter uses first, then the most used, then the rest). Unset: by component name. docs/integrity.md, "Unreviewed baselines".

byStory.description: Whether the dashboard may approve a story's waiting entries (each mode and state) together, in one batch. Off: each entry is approved on its own, after it is looked at.

dashboard.description: The dashboard rebuilt on this project's design system (`pxsig dashboard build`).

ui.description: The UI adapter: a path to its module (a file, or a folder with an index file), relative to this folder, or a built-in adapter's name. See docs/ui/build-adapter.md.

rejections.description: A rejection's note and its packet (reports/rejected/<id>/: rejection.md, rejection.json, the images and full-size crops of the changed regions), in the store's git-ignored reports/, never committed. See docs/configuration.md#rejections.

ask.description: Reject asks for an optional reason in the dashboard; false: Reject and R reject at once.

packet.description: Write rejection packets; false: the note only.

pad.description: Padding around each changed region, in px; padded regions that overlap merge.

max.description: Crops per packet, the most changed pixels first.

scale.description: Nearest-neighbour upscale: auto brings the short side to at least 160 px, at most 4x; never past 1,024 px on the long side.

annotate.description: Outline each changed region on the crops.

structure.description: A folder, relative to this one, of committed structure locks (<section>/<name>.aria.yml) to compare with the store's reports/structure/; rejection.md then has a Structure section.
